fact.title: Unbroken Crown internal oath and coercive purpose — GM background
fact.statement: The Unbroken Crown cell led by Caldus Vane uses a plain-language internal oath renouncing human kings, promising obedience to the inhuman Dragon Kings and accepting the subjection of unwilling humans. Its public appeal is veteran fellowship, rank and order. Vane authorises intimidation, abduction and armed resistance with finite people and resources. There is no cell spellcaster, working compulsion, confirmed living Dragon King or established Hanzo command. This is prepared GM background, not new PC knowledge.

fact.title: Dane’s limited knowledge of customer Caldus Vane — GM background
fact.statement: Merrit Dane knows Caldus Vane as an arms customer and veteran-meeting host at Reedgate. Dane has the d43/dusk invitation and heard “brothers of the oath,” but has not read the internal oath or learned the plan against Mara. Dane’s receipt packet contains Vane’s old introduction asking him to receive Dame Avel Veyr and her ancestral proofs; Dane treated it as a commercial referral and did not know or fund her Greywatch plan. No PC or Lysa has yet been given Vane’s name, place, invitation or introduction.
fact.narrative: The specific Vane-Avel introduction is an independent evidence route. It does not make Dane party to Greywatch.

fact.title: The Veyr heirlooms are imperial propaganda for human subjection
fact.statement: Avel’s inherited ceremonial mail reads PEACE THROUGH OBEDIENCE and praises an ancestor for returning reed households to their appointed lord. Beneath the inner collar, THE CROWNED BREATH ENTERS THE WORTHY CAPTAIN is a historical possession dedication, not an active spell or usable ritual. Her dragon signet shows a kneeling human whose worn lower edge retains a collar-chain. The Veyr chronicle calls refugees strayed dependants, forced levies restored households and executions the quieting of disorder. These objects are authentic propaganda, not enchanted mind control.
fact.narrative: The inner formula made literal return seem plausible to Avel. Vane and Cassian recognized its historical connection to captain-possession while withholding every practical dependency.

beat.title: Apply the saved report-and-capacity reaction matrix
beat.summary: No reaction until Vane actually knows interference; then use only surviving assets and cancel impossible operations.
beat.onscreen_if: Actual report reaches Vane and produces movement, negotiation, evidence destruction or retreat observable in play.
beat.narrative: Mara protected: abort U1 after survivor report; max2GP public offer/bribe, never storm staffed post. Dane cuts contact: lose sales/cache route, no revenge. Lost follower: reduce force after actual report/missed rendezvous, no replacements. Watch exposed:20min burn specified hall copies,1h move portable cash/pledge/seal with present people; external copies survive, no new hideout. Infiltrator detected: challenge/disarm/detain only with actual guards. Recruit refuses: withdraw/persuade or actual detention, no mind control. Courier protected: cancel U5/U6; open blockade only with three fighters/food. Avel capture: only after letter/report, draft disavowal and max2GP lawful visitor/bribe; no raid/assassin. Awake-the-Dragon link exposed: burn only the local Cassian letter if still held, cancel U8; Cassian is not warned and his Purewater counterpart survives. Defeat: surrender/retreat, all Vane-led operations cease.
beat.agenda_title: Respond only to interference Vane actually learns
